entities.summary: Takashi Matsumoto (b. 1949-07-16, Minato) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Minato and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
